newsitem.title: USA: Amoco to double styrene capacity at Texas plant.
newsitem.headline: Amoco to double styrene capacity at Texas plant.

text.p: Amoco Corp said it plans to add one billion pounds per year of styrene production capacity to a Texas City, Texas, plant by early 2000.
The plant presently has styrene production capacity of about one billion pounds per year, the company said.
Styrene plastic is used in packaging, electronic components, housewares and building materials.
"Discussions with several third parties are already underway for long term offtake of styrene monomer," said the producer of oil, natural gas and petrochemicals.
Costs of the project were not disclosed.
Amoco said it realized revenues from olefins, aromatics and styrene products of $903 million in 1996.
